tasks.ArrangeDemocrats: Arranging the 5 Democrats around a circular table such that all sit next to each other.
tasks.ArrangeIndependent: Placing the Independent member in one of the gaps between the two groups (Democrats and Republicans).
tasks.ArrangeRepublicans: Arranging the 5 Republicans around a circular table such that all sit next to each other.
tasks.CalculateWays: Calculating the total number of ways based on the arrangements of Democrats, Republicans, and the Independent.
